name: Hemolytic anemia due to pyrimidine 5' nucleotidase deficiency

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic criteria for pyrimidine 5' nucleotidase deficiency

criteria.description: Reduced pyrimidine 5' nucleotidase enzyme activity in erythrocytes
Presence of chronic hemolytic anemia with reticulocytosis
Detection of basophilic stippling or Heinz bodies in peripheral blood smear
Identification of pathogenic mutations in the NT5C3A gene

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Reduced enzyme activity plus clinical evidence of chronic hemolytic anemia
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing supports diagnosis but is not mandatory.
